note: 1.14 moves no served figure. The server gains one filter key, cover_lt2 (coverWeeks < 2, the predicate the Overview's coverUnder2w counts with, coverUnderTwoWeeks), and the filter switch moves verbatim out of listItems into the pure filterItems (its applyFilter also names the key applied); no capture requests cover_lt2, so no capture can change. /items also echoes the filter it applied (additive `filter`, "all" for none or an unknown key, as `sort` echoes the order), which a 1.14 tab reads to tell whether a server knew cover_lt2. Everything else is in the browser: the Overview tiles open their filter on a fresh Inventory view (public/inventory.js overviewTileHash), the Used in cell shows max(parentCountDeep, parentCount) (fields every item already carries) and the Inventory subtitle is reworded. Every capture (items, items.csv, cart.json, cart.csv, suppliers, overview, divergence, item and kit pages) must be identical apart from the release block /sync/status reports and that new items.json `filter`; anything else changing is a failure.
